9	// Identifies what a picked Drive folder should be applied to: a subfolder
10	// group (by its path key) or an individual file (by its filesystem path).
11	export type PickerTarget = { type: 'group'; key: string } | { type: 'file'; path: string }

13	export interface DriveAssignmentsHandle {
14	  groupAssignments: Map<string, DriveAssignment>
15	  fileOverrides: Map<string, DriveAssignment>
16	  setGroupAssignment: (groupKey: string, assignment: DriveAssignment) => void
17	  clearGroupAssignment: (groupKey: string) => void
18	  setFileOverride: (filePath: string, assignment: DriveAssignment) => void
19	  clearFileOverride: (filePath: string) => void
20	}

22	// Tracks Drive folder assignments made directly on a subfolder group or on
23	// an individual file (a file-level assignment overrides its group's).
24	// Resolving the *effective* assignment for a given group/file (own, else
25	// inherited from the nearest ancestor group, else none) is the caller's
26	// job, since only the caller knows the tree structure to walk.
27	export function useDriveAssignments(): DriveAssignmentsHandle {
28	  const [groupAssignments, setGroupAssignments] = useState<Map<string, DriveAssignment>>(new Map())
29	  const [fileOverrides, setFileOverrides] = useState<Map<string, DriveAssignment>>(new Map())
30	
31	  const setGroupAssignment = useCallback((groupKey: string, assignment: DriveAssignment) => {
32	    setGroupAssignments(prev => new Map(prev).set(groupKey, assignment))
33	  }, [])
34	
35	  const clearGroupAssignment = useCallback((groupKey: string) => {
36	    setGroupAssignments(prev => {
37	      const next = new Map(prev)
38	      next.delete(groupKey)
39	      return next
40	    })
41	  }, [])
42	
43	  const setFileOverride = useCallback((filePath: string, assignment: DriveAssignment) => {
44	    setFileOverrides(prev => new Map(prev).set(filePath, assignment))
45	  }, [])
46	
47	  const clearFileOverride = useCallback((filePath: string) => {
48	    setFileOverrides(prev => {
49	      const next = new Map(prev)
50	      next.delete(filePath)
51	      return next
52	    })
53	  }, [])
54	
55	  return { groupAssignments, fileOverrides, setGroupAssignment, clearGroupAssignment, setFileOverride, clearFileOverride }
56	}

58	// Effective Drive assignment for every file in the tree: its own override,
59	// else the nearest ancestor group's assignment, else null. Mirrors the
60	// inheritance walk GroupNode/FileList do inline during render (same
61	// groupKey scheme: joined by '/', rooted at each top-level subgroup's own
62	// name), but usable outside a render tree — e.g. to check whether every
63	// file is ready to upload, or to build an upload job list.
64	export function resolveEffectiveAssignments(
65	  tree: LocalFileGroup,
66	  { groupAssignments, fileOverrides }: Pick<DriveAssignmentsHandle, 'groupAssignments' | 'fileOverrides'>
67	): Map<string, DriveAssignment | null> {
68	  const result = new Map<string, DriveAssignment | null>()
69	
70	  const walk = (group: LocalFileGroup, groupKey: string | null, inherited: DriveAssignment | null) => {
71	    const effective = (groupKey !== null ? groupAssignments.get(groupKey) : undefined) ?? inherited
72	    for (const file of group.files) {
73	      result.set(file.path, fileOverrides.get(file.path) ?? effective)
74	    }
75	    for (const sub of group.subgroups) {
76	      walk(sub, groupKey !== null ? `${groupKey}/${sub.name}` : sub.name, effective)
77	    }
78	  }
79	  walk(tree, null, null)
80	
81	  return result
82	}

19	// Flat, ordered list of every file in the tree (a group's own files, then
20	// its subgroups' files, recursively). Shared by the upload worker (order to
21	// process files in), the upload modal's per-group rollup counts, and the
22	// "every file in this group is done" check driving the Open-in-Drive link —
23	// one traversal so they can't drift out of sync on how they handle nesting.
24	export function flattenFiles(group: LocalFileGroup): LocalFile[] {
25	  return [...group.files, ...group.subgroups.flatMap(flattenFiles)]
26	}

28	export interface FileTreeHandle {
29	  root: string | null
30	  tree: LocalFileGroup | null
31	  loading: boolean
32	  error: string | null
33	  // Resolves to whether a folder was actually picked (false if the user
34	  // cancelled the dialog), so callers know when a fresh root replaced the
35	  // previous one and any per-root state (e.g. the upload queue) should reset.
36	  pickRoot: () => Promise<boolean>
37	}

39	export function useFileTree(): FileTreeHandle {
40	  const [root, setRoot] = useState<string | null>(null)
41	  const [tree, setTree] = useState<LocalFileGroup | null>(null)
42	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
43	  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
44	
45	  const pickRoot = useCallback(async () => {
46	    const folder = await PickFolder('Choose Root Folder')
47	    if (!folder) return false
48	
49	    setRoot(folder)
50	    setLoading(true)
51	    setError(null)
52	    try {
53	      setTree(await ScanLocalRoot(folder))
54	    } catch (e) {
55	      setTree(null)
56	      setError(String(e))
57	    } finally {
58	      setLoading(false)
59	    }
60	    return true
61	  }, [])

1	import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react'
2	import { LocalFileGroup, flattenFiles } from './useFileTree'
3	
4	export type GroupSelectionState = 'checked' | 'unchecked' | 'indeterminate'
5	
6	export interface InclusionHandle {
7	  isFileSelected: (path: string) => boolean
8	  getGroupState: (group: LocalFileGroup) => GroupSelectionState
9	  toggleFile: (path: string) => void
10	  toggleGroup: (group: LocalFileGroup) => void
11	  selectAll: () => void
12	  selectNone: () => void
13	}
14	
15	// Tracks which files are excluded from the upload, keyed by path. A
16	// subfolder's checkbox state is derived from its descendant files rather
17	// than stored separately, so the "fully selected/unselected collapses all
18	// the way up the tree" behavior falls out of the derivation for free
19	// instead of needing explicit upward-propagation bookkeeping.
20	export function useInclusion(tree: LocalFileGroup | null): InclusionHandle {
21	  const [deselected, setDeselected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
22	
23	  // Resets to fully-selected on every fresh scan — deliberately not
24	  // persisted, unlike Drive folder mappings.
25	  useEffect(() => {
26	    setDeselected(new Set())
27	  }, [tree])
28	
29	  const isFileSelected = useCallback((path: string) => !deselected.has(path), [deselected])
30	
31	  const getGroupState = useCallback((group: LocalFileGroup): GroupSelectionState => {
32	    const files = flattenFiles(group)
33	    if (files.length === 0) return 'checked'
34	    const selectedCount = files.filter(f => !deselected.has(f.path)).length
35	    if (selectedCount === 0) return 'unchecked'
36	    if (selectedCount === files.length) return 'checked'
37	    return 'indeterminate'
38	  }, [deselected])
39	
40	  const toggleFile = useCallback((path: string) => {
41	    setDeselected(prev => {
42	      const next = new Set(prev)
43	      if (next.has(path)) next.delete(path); else next.add(path)
44	      return next
45	    })
46	  }, [])
47	
48	  // Indeterminate or fully-unselected groups select all descendants; a
49	  // fully-selected group deselects all descendants. Decided from the
50	  // group's own current state rather than the checkbox's native toggle, so
51	  // clicking an indeterminate checkbox always selects, never clears.
52	  const toggleGroup = useCallback((group: LocalFileGroup) => {
53	    const files = flattenFiles(group)
54	    setDeselected(prev => {
55	      const allSelected = files.every(f => !prev.has(f.path))
56	      const next = new Set(prev)
57	      for (const f of files) {
58	        if (allSelected) next.add(f.path); else next.delete(f.path)
59	      }
60	      return next
61	    })
62	  }, [])
63	
64	  const selectAll = useCallback(() => setDeselected(new Set()), [])
65	
66	  const selectNone = useCallback(() => {
67	    setDeselected(new Set(tree ? flattenFiles(tree).map(f => f.path) : []))
68	  }, [tree])
69	
70	  return { isFileSelected, getGroupState, toggleFile, toggleGroup, selectAll, selectNone }
71	}

1	import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react'
2	import { LocalFileGroup } from './useFileTree'
3	
4	export type SelectionItem = { type: 'file'; path: string } | { type: 'group'; key: string }
5	
6	function itemKey(item: SelectionItem): string {
7	  return item.type === 'file' ? `file:${item.path}` : `group:${item.key}`
8	}
9	
10	export interface SelectionHandle {
11	  size: number
12	  isSelected: (item: SelectionItem) => boolean
13	  // Plain click: replaces the selection with just this item.
14	  replace: (item: SelectionItem) => void
15	  // Cmd/Ctrl-click: adds or removes this item from the existing selection.
16	  toggle: (item: SelectionItem) => void
17	}
18	
19	// The shared multi-selection of files and subfolders driving both row
20	// highlighting and (Step 3e) batch Drive folder assignment — a single
21	// selection concept rather than a separate preview-only highlight.
22	export function useSelection(tree: LocalFileGroup | null): SelectionHandle {
23	  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Map<string, SelectionItem>>(new Map())
24	
25	  // Resets on every fresh scan, like inclusion — a new root's rows aren't
26	  // the ones that were selected under the old one.
27	  useEffect(() => {
28	    setSelected(new Map())
29	  }, [tree])
30	
31	  const isSelected = useCallback((item: SelectionItem) => selected.has(itemKey(item)), [selected])
32	
33	  const replace = useCallback((item: SelectionItem) => {
34	    setSelected(new Map([[itemKey(item), item]]))
35	  }, [])
36	
37	  const toggle = useCallback((item: SelectionItem) => {
38	    setSelected(prev => {
39	      const key = itemKey(item)
40	      const next = new Map(prev)
41	      if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key); else next.set(key, item)
42	      return next
43	    })
44	  }, [])
45	
46	  return { size: selected.size, isSelected, replace, toggle }
47	}

**3e-i is implemented and tested.** It covers the multi-selection interaction model:

- New `useSelection` hook: a shared `SelectionItem` set (files by path, groups by key) with `replace` (plain click) and `toggle` (Cmd/Ctrl-click) semantics, resetting on a fresh root scan.
- `GroupNode`: split the old single toggle button into a dedicated chevron (always expand/collapse, never selection) and a name button (selection click, with the ≤1-item convenience expand/collapse rule).
- `FileList`: row click now drives the shared selection (plain replaces, Cmd/Ctrl toggles) instead of the old single `selectedPath`; preview (`onSelectFile`) still fires on every click of a previewable file, unchanged.
- Added `stopPropagation` on the checkbox and Drive-assignment badge inside file rows — needed once row clicks affect real multi-select state, so checking a box or opening the folder picker no longer collapses your selection out from under you.
